newsitem.title: GERMANY: Porsche Q1 sales soar 40 pct.
newsitem.headline: Porsche Q1 sales soar 40 pct.

text.p: German sports car maker Dr. Ing. h. c. f. Porsche AG said on Tuesday that first-quarter sales climbed 40 percent to 822 million marks due in large part to strong demand for its 911 model in the U.S., Porsche's largest car market.
Porsche chairman Wendelin Wiedeking said in a speech that unit sales climbed 55 percent during the August-to-October period to 6,181 units.
"More than half of our sales of 911 models, that is exactly 3,192 cars, was in North Amercia, representing an increase by no less than 90 percent over the same period last year," Wiedeking said.
Wiedeking said that by the end of November production of Porsche's two models, the Boxster and the 911, was split 40-60.
Porsche is aiming for a 50-50 balance of the two cars at the beginning of 1997.
